instruction: Change Chrome's default search engine to Bing.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully enabled Do Not Track in Chrome by navigating Settings > Privacy and Security > Third-party cookies, toggling the DNT option, and confirming the dialog. Completed in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome menu, navigate to Settings, find specific settings sections, toggle switches, and confirm dialog prompts.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests Chrome settings navigation in a different section (Search engine). Requires finding and using a dropdown selector rather than a toggle, adding variety to the interaction pattern.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome Search engine settings and changing the default search engine to Bing. Evaluator uses official default_search_engine getter and exact_match metric.

scoring_breakdown.search_engine_change: 1.0 - Default search engine set to Bing

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'default_search_engine' correctly reads Chrome's Preferences JSON file and extracts the search engine short_name, which is the right state for verifying the instruction.
Metric 'exact_match' correctly compares the extracted search engine name against the expected value 'Bing' using strict equality, appropriate for this task.
Expected value 'Bing' matches Chrome's internal short_name for the Bing search engine.
Postconfig correctly kills and relaunches Chrome to ensure the Preferences file is written to disk and up-to-date before the getter reads it.
Instruction has a single requirement (change default search engine to Bing) and the evaluator fully covers it.
